settings.custom_liquid:
For your quote

Before you quote the school or team order

  1. Roster

    Count every wearer by style, color and size: youth, women’s, tall, extended adult and toddler sizes included. Price each companion style, not the adult tee alone.

  2. School color

    Check the exact shade and available quantities in each style and size. Shade names and stock differ between styles, so agree on a backup color.

  3. Production

    Include blank cost, shipping, decoration, names and numbers, sorting by player or class, and packing in your estimate.

  4. Handoff date

    Work back from the date students, players or families need the finished garments to allow time for blank delivery, approvals and production. Set any preorder or fundraiser close date with those steps in mind.
